title: A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility
use: HAR motivation only; our cross-session HAR includes a prior-day variance control and is not an exact replication of Corsi.

title: Volatility forecast comparison using imperfect volatility proxies
use: QLIKE proxy-robust rankings require a conditionally unbiased proxy. Native M5 equivalence does not prove that assumption. MAE is a secondary guardrail, not a proxy-robust variance ranking guarantee.

title: Tests of Conditional Predictive Ability
use: Motivation for forecast-method evaluation and estimation uncertainty. Their rolling finite-memory framework is not claimed as a theorem for our one-time frozen fit.

title: Fixed-b Subsampling and Block Bootstrap: Improved Confidence Sets Based on P-value Calibration
authors: Xiaofeng Shao and Dimitris N. Politis
use: Motivation to evaluate block-size-dependent finite-sample coverage, not a claim that our calibrated max-SE interval implements their specific method.

title: Bootstrapping Generalization Error Bounds for Time Series
authors: Robert Lunde and Cosma Rohilla Shalizi
use: Risk inference needs mixing/smoothness assumptions. Our generator validation is conditional evidence, not a proof that all those assumptions hold for XAUUSD.
